# Career Command Resume + Job Fit Audit

Capability ID: career-command-resume-job-fit-machine-v1
Commercial state: verify
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://evercraft-career-command.base44.app/
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- check my resume against this job
- why am I not getting interviews
- tailor my resume to this opening
- is my resume ATS friendly
- what am I missing for this job
- resume job match
- audit my resume

## Problem

A job seeker has a real opening and needs an evidence-backed comparison between their supplied background and the target role without fabricated credentials or fake proprietary ATS certainty.

## Inputs

Candidate-supplied resume or background plus the target job description. Optional skills, achievements and company context.

## Outputs

Strongest proof anchors, job-fit evidence, generic or unsupported claims, missing evidence, highest-impact edits and a truthful rewritten summary.

## Pricing

Free core is available. No premium machine-lane price is approved yet.

- Resume + Job Fit Audit: $0 core
